description:
Get comprehensive font metrics for a specified font. Returns all available metrics including x-height, cap-height, ascender, descender, line gap, underline/strikeout positions, subscript/superscript sizes, and bounding box.

The tool searches system fonts (including .ttc collections such as Helvetica), the fonts bundled with InDesign (e.g. Minion Pro, Myriad Pro), and Adobe Fonts installed via Creative Cloud.

IMPORTANT: Adobe Fonts limitation - Some Adobe Fonts are loaded on-demand by Adobe apps and may not be locally cached in the CoreSync folder. If a font is available in InDesign but not found by this tool, the user should:
1. Open Adobe Creative Cloud → Fonts
2. Find the font and click the Download icon to install it locally
3. Use refresh=true after installation to rebuild the font cache

Parameters:
- fontIdentifier: Font name to search for (family name, PostScript name, or full name)
- style: Optional style specifier to disambiguate (e.g., "Bold", "Italic")
- refresh: Force rebuild of font cache (use after installing new fonts)

All metric values are in font units. Divide by unitsPerEm and multiply by point size to get actual measurements.

Example: For a 12pt font with unitsPerEm=1000 and xHeight=500:
  Actual x-height = (500 / 1000) * 12 = 6pt

fontIdentifier.description: Font identifier - family name (e.g., 'Helvetica'), PostScript name (e.g., 'Helvetica-Bold'), or full name

refresh.description: Force refresh of font cache (rebuilds index from disk)

style.description: Optional style (e.g., 'Bold', 'Italic') to disambiguate multiple matches

name: get_font_metrics

ascender.description: Distance from baseline to top of tallest glyph (in font units)

bbox.description: Bounding box enclosing all glyphs in the font (in font units)

xMin.description: Left edge of font bounding box

capHeight.description: Height of capital letters (in font units)

capHeightSource.description: Whether capHeight came from font metadata or was measured from glyphs

descender.description: Distance from baseline to bottom of lowest glyph (negative, in font units)

faceIndex.description: Face index inside a font collection (.ttc); absent for single-font files

filePath.description: Absolute path to the font file on disk

fullName.description: Complete font name including family and style

isMonospace.description: True if all glyphs have equal width (e.g., Courier, Consolas)

lineGap.description: Recommended additional line spacing (in font units)

postScriptName.description: PostScript name for precise font identification

underlinePosition.description: Vertical position for underline (negative = below baseline)

unitsPerEm.description: Font units per em. Divide other metrics by this and multiply by point size to get actual measurements

xHeight.description: Height of lowercase 'x' (in font units). Key for optical alignment

xHeightSource.description: Whether xHeight came from font metadata or was measured from glyphs
